title: Secret Prompt to make millions with Claude AI business hack  #ai #business #claudeai
description:
Broke? No website? No audience? No problem. In this video I show you how to start a real service business this weekend using nothing but Claude and LinkedIn DMs.

The setup: laid-off professionals are one of the most motivated buyer groups on the internet right now. They have money (severance), urgency (bills), and a clear pain (getting a job). LinkedIn hands you a free list of them with the #opentowork banner.

Your job: rewrite their resume and LinkedIn headline using Claude, charge $75, deliver in a Google Doc within 24 hours.

What you'll learn:

How to find qualified buyers on LinkedIn in under 60 seconds
The exact DM script that gets replies without sounding spammy
The exact recruiter-grade Claude prompt I use — copy it from the pinned comment, works for any industry

How to deliver and get paid with zero tools — just Google Docs and Venmo
How to scale this to 3-5 clients a day without burning out

Zero cost. Zero website. Zero inventory. You can start before the video ends.
Drop a comment if you land your first client this week — I want to hear the numbers.

#ClaudeAI #SideHustle #NoCodeBusiness #MakeMoneyOnline #LinkedInTips #ResumeWriting
